scope: Bounded, public, read-only pull tests continued: Data29 monthly seasonality. No credentials used, no access-control bypass.

evidence.name: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments - monthly data
evidence.schema_observation: SDMX 2.1 JSON; dims freq(M), c_resid(DOM/FOR/TOTAL), unit(NR/PCH_SM/PCH_SM_2Y/PCH_SM_19), nace_r2(I551-I553..I553), geo, time(monthly YYYY-MM). Monthly time codes use 'YYYY-MM' format (not 'YYYY-MMM'/'YYYYM01').
evidence.note: Monthly nights VERIFIED at COUNTRY level (geo=EL) only. NUTS2 (geo=EL62) returns an empty value set (size geo=0) — Eurostat does not publish monthly NUTS2 for tour_occ_nim. Data29 seasonality is therefore country-level Greece as a documented proxy.

evidence.name: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments - monthly data (NUTS2 availability probe)
evidence.schema_observation: HTTP 200 but empty value set; size array shows geo=0 (EL62 not in the geo codelist for this monthly dataset). Confirms no NUTS2 monthly publication.
evidence.note: Negative probe: NUTS2 monthly seasonality is not available from Eurostat tour_occ_nim. Recorded as an access constraint, not as 'source does not exist'.

evidence.name: Bathing Water Directive - Status of bathing water (assessment results, Discodata SQL API)
evidence.provider: European Environment Agency (EEA) - WISE Bathing Water

request_params.query: SELECT quality, COUNT(*) AS n FROM [WISE_BWD].[latest].[assessment_BathingWaterStatus] WHERE countryCode='EL' AND season=2024 GROUP BY quality ORDER BY n DESC

evidence.schema_observation: Discodata SQL over HTTP (SQL Server T-SQL dialect; TOP not LIMIT). Table [WISE_BWD].[latest].[assessment_BathingWaterStatus] cols: countryCode, bathingWaterIdentifier, specialisedZoneType, season, quality ('1 - Excellent'..'4 - Poor', '0 - Not classified').
evidence.note: Greece 2024 (latest): Excellent 1677, Good 15, Sufficient 1, Poor 1, Not classified 35 (total 1729; 1728 coastal + 1 lake). % excellent = 96.99% of total / 99.00% of classified. Country-level only in this table; NUTS2 (EL62) attribution needs a spatial join (bathingWaterIdentifier -> coordinates).

evidence.name: Bathing water specialised zone type (Greece 2024)
evidence.provider: European Environment Agency (EEA) - WISE Bathing Water

request_params.query: SELECT specialisedZoneType, COUNT(*) AS n FROM [WISE_BWD].[latest].[assessment_BathingWaterStatus] WHERE countryCode='EL' AND season=2024 GROUP BY specialisedZoneType ORDER BY n DESC
